content_of_post_to_answer: Is the shift toward a domestic role more of a personality change than a simple change in routine?
answer: A domestic role can change personality, but often by bringing previously underused parts of it to the surface. Someone who was ambitious, independent or socially driven doesn't necessarily become less so; their attention and priorities simply reorganize. The subtle shift is that identity starts being measured less by external achievement and more by the quality of everyday care. I've explored this tension further in other writing on my Quora profile. The real distinction is between changing who you are and changing what gets to define you.
